needsVerification: PARTIAL. The client supplies only id and name; zones for ~259 entries come from the Hunting Log. EVERYTHING ELSE IS CURATED from the Final Fantasy Wiki (see curatedFields) and carries that source's caveats - the wiki states plainly that its classifications are part conjecture, and its levels/HP/abilities are editor-recorded rather than extracted. It documents the notable ~3,500 of these 14,560, so most entries still have nothing. 'drops' stays ??? for every entry: mob loot tables are server-side and absent from client data (Q11, settled).
